000.$description: Pure white. Panel fills that must sit above paper.

050.$description: Warm paper. Kept slightly warm, the same value the mothership uses.

100.$description: One step down from paper. Calm hover wash.

150.$description: The second stripe of the light hatch. Sits between 100 and paper on purpose, so the hatch reads as texture and never as a filled block.

300.$description: Heavy border. The canvas names this one directly: panel 1px hairline, heavy border.

400.$description: Quiet decorative marks, and secondary text on ink.

500.$description: The dimmest readable text tone. Machine-voice metadata that must recede without disappearing.

700.$description: Carried from the house ramp for parity. Unused by The Index so far.

900.$description: The first stripe of the dark hatch, and raised panels on ink.

925.$description: The second stripe of the dark hatch. The dark mirror of gray.150.

950.$description: Cool ink. Kept slightly cool, the same value the mothership uses.

on-paper.$description: Both live marks, verified this sweep and re-verified, on a light surface. BUILD.md ruling 1: nudged one digit from the canvas #1E7A46, which was 4.45:1 on a hovered row. This clears 4.51:1 there and 4.97:1 on paper.

on-ink.$description: Both live marks on a dark surface. 8.87:1 on gray.950, clears AA.

on-paper.$description: The sweep is old and the site says so. 5.65:1 on the worst light ground, clears AA. Amber because it is a warning about our own freshness, not a claim about an employer.

on-ink.$description: The same warning on a dark surface. 7.41:1 on the worst dark ground, clears AA.

on-paper.$description: The kill and ghost statistics on a light surface. 5.94:1 on gray.050, clears AA.

on-ink.$description: The kill and ghost statistics on a dark surface. 7.91:1 on gray.950, clears AA. The pair is required, not optional: the on-paper value is only 3.04:1 on ink and would fail gate 1.

on-paper.$description: The draft room's marker highlight on paper: the exact cream DraftRoomV2 had hardcoded as rgb(239, 231, 200) before this became a token, so the light theme is unchanged to the pixel.

on-ink.$description: Its mirror on ink. The highlight has to keep meaning the same thing in both themes, and a warm tint that the page's own foreground reads on top of is what does that. The cream did NOT survive the flip: on a gray.900 card it painted a light slab with hardcoded near-black text, and because each wrapped line is its own box, the right edge came out ragged. On /how-it-works it read as a broken image, which is how this was found.

base.$description: Signal orange. The one accent on this marketing site, from the Anti Algo how-it-works canvas. Emphasis on the index stays inversion-only; here the signal marks the one thing that acts: the waitlist. Same value in both themes so the brand reads identically on paper and ink.
